svg.text: Unconstrained cage-level ANCOVA estimates · equal cohort averaging · pointwise 95% confidence intervals
they do not imply equal doses.
Means are not forced to be ordered.
p tests the whole ordered pattern,
Exploratory tests: p-values allow either increasing or decreasing order; no across-outcome adjustment.
Only speed, stopping, slip count and tail score were tested for order. Outcome selection was informed by the data.
Intervals assume constant error variance; few cages and influential observations limit precision. See methods and sensitivity results.
